description: The shipped ContextPolicy constants the published agentic evidence stands on. Editing a constant in src/llb/bench/agentic/context.py without editing its pin here fails the CI pin gate, which names the published cells the change invalidates.

observation_cap_chars.note: Pinned by the 2026-07-30 context-policy constant sweep (cap=400 separates worse on completion, cap=1600 is flat). Every published cap-fitting cell trims its padded observations under it, so both arms of all 22 cells move from model call 2 if it is re-pinned.

observation_head_share.note: Pinned by the same sweep (0.5 / 0.7 flat on completion). Changes the trimmed observation text itself, so it moves every published cell exactly as the cap does.

keep_last_n.note: Shipped at 3 and EXPOSED rather than rewritten by the constant sweep (keep=1 is flat on completion and cheaper on prompt tokens). The constant-sweep and keep-long designs hold it fixed at 3 under the keep_last_n policy, so a re-pin invalidates those shipped baselines even though no cap-fitting cell runs that policy.

compact_share.note: The share the boundary surface and the fold-step crossover hold fixed. The trigger collapse SWEEPS it cell by cell, so those cells pin the field as their own study axis and a change does not describe them.

compact_keep_recent.note: One recent step is the minimum that keeps a compacting loop from repeating its last tool call, and the largest keep that still lets compaction fire on a two-step transcript. Not stated in any design's held_fixed, but every compact arm runs under it, so a change moves every published cell.

summary_input_cap.note: The three designs record `trigger`, the retired bound they were measured under. The crossover restatement audited all 22 cells under both bounds, found 18 bit-identical, re-measured the one bound-sensitive cell that was still outstanding, and restated the published crossovers under `window` -- so `window` is the value the published numbers now stand under.
